base-lyra design system style
nodes.rationale: shadcn/ui style 'lyra' with base color 'mist' and zero border-radius everywhere, chosen because Rikuna is a utilitarian data-decision tool, not a social app; the real project migrated the Radix-based 'lyra' onto a Base UI variant named 'base-lyra' in components.json, diverging from this doc's own config snippet.
